obligations.expression:
for scope in PriorityScopes:
        scope.members.count = scope.members.unique.count

Verify invariant PriorityJudgmentsAreSiblingOnly holds after every state-changing rule that touches constrained entities
obligations.expression:
for judgment in PriorityJudgments:
        judgment.more_important != judgment.less_important
        and judgment.scope_revision <= judgment.scope.revision
        and (
            not judgment.applicable
            or (
                judgment.more_important in judgment.scope.members
                and judgment.less_important in judgment.scope.members

obligations.description: Verify invariant PrioritySkipThresholdIsPositive holds after every state-changing rule that touches constrained entities
Verify invariant PriorityProbeIsSiblingScoped holds after every state-changing rule that touches constrained entities
obligations.expression:
for probe in JudgmentProbes:
        probe.axis = priority implies
            (
                probe.scope != null
                and (
                    probe.status = resolved
                    or (
                        probe.left in probe.scope.members
                        and probe.right in probe.scope.members

obligations.description: Verify invariant ImpactProbeIsRootScoped holds after every state-changing rule that touches constrained entities
obligations.expression:
for probe in JudgmentProbes:
        probe.axis = impact implies
            probe.left.parent = null
            and probe.right.parent = null

obligations.description: Verify invariant EffortProbeUsesApplicableBricks holds after every state-changing rule that touches constrained entities
obligations.expression:
for probe in JudgmentProbes:
        probe.axis = effort implies
            probe.left.behavior.effort = applicable
            and probe.right.behavior.effort = applicable

obligations.description: Verify invariant JudgmentProbeComparesDistinctBricks holds after every state-changing rule that touches constrained entities
obligations.expression:
for probe in JudgmentProbes:
        probe.left != probe.right
